meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 在成功执行编辑类操作后,插件自动运行注释检查;若有警告,Claude 会先修复或解释被标记的注释,再继续后续工作。
howto.when: 每次成功调用 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作后触发;若检查器报告警告,会阻塞并反馈给 Claude。

say.text: 请修复刚才那个注释检查警告
say.note: 会触发对警告注释的修复处理

say.text: 解释一下这条注释警告的原因
say.note: 说明警告含义,便于你判断

say.text: 把代码里所有不合规的注释都改掉
say.note: 会逐条处理并更新注释

howto.what_en: After successful edit operations, the plugin automatically runs a comment checker; if warnings appear, Claude must fix or explain the flagged comments before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggered after each successful edit-like call (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.); non-edit tools are ignored. Warnings block and are reported back.

say_en.text: Fix that comment-checker warning just now.
Explain why this comment warning appeared.
say_en.note: Clarifies the warning for your judgment.

say_en.text: Rewrite all non-compliant comments in the code.
say_en.note: Processes each one and updates comments.
